rule.never: no term is taken from, or filtered by, any model output, decode, provider hypothesis or error analysis

common_word_stoplist.rule_a: normalized alias (whole alias, any length) occurs >= 5 times in the 220 benchmark windows (66912 tokens) of the eight cities that are NOT argos/orestiada. Rejection only.
common_word_stoplist.rule_b: single-token place/organisation alias is a lowercase (common-noun) headword of el_GR hunspell (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries/master/el_GR/el_GR.dic)
common_word_stoplist.rule_b_deviation: Codex advised recording rule_b as a diagnostic only. It is enforced here because the seen-city corpus is ~67k tokens, too small for rule_a to reject Γυμνό/Εξοχή/Λίμνες/Αεροδρόμιο; every rule_b rejection is listed in dropped_aliases.

rule.given_names: standalone given names are NOT terms; full names are atomic multi-token terms instead (G6)
rule.aliases_from: fixed Greek suffix rules in scripts/build_ds_wer_terms.py::inflect for single-token person names and their full-name cross product; otherwise the source string verbatim
rule.osm_merge_rule: an OSM nominative merges into the ELSTAT community term when the normalized first tokens share a >= 5 character prefix and the match is unique; otherwise it becomes a separate place_settlement_osm term
rule.alias_normalization: aliases are stored already normalized by the frozen scorer (eval.controlled_eval.eval_freeze.ftoks); the matcher uses the same normalizer
rule.collision_rule: an alias claimed by more than one term is dropped from every term that claims it
